headline: BNDES Disburses R$ 2.7 Billion to Latam Airlines to Cushion Fuel Cost Pressures
summary: BNDES disbursed R$ 2.664 billion from the National Civil Aviation Fund to Latam Airlines Brasil as working capital to reinforce liquidity against high fuel costs.
why: State-backed aviation financing facilities provide vital liquidity support to airlines navigating volatile jet fuel prices and capital-intensive operations.

impacts.name: Latam Airlines Brasil
impacts.why: Government-backed credit lines enhance cash reserves and liquidity buffers for air carriers.
